Q1.en: Write each number as a product of primes: \(12 = 2^2 \times 3\) and \(20 = 2^2 \times 5\). The LCM takes the highest power of every prime: \(2^2 \times 3 \times 5 = 60\), which is the choice 60.
Q1.hi: दोनों संख्याओं के अभाज्य गुणनखंड हैं: \(12 = 2^2 \times 3\) तथा \(20 = 2^2 \times 5\)। LCM में प्रत्येक अभाज्य गुणनखंड की सबसे बड़ी घात ली जाती है: \(2^2 \times 3 \times 5 = 60\)। अतः सही विकल्प 60 है।

Q2.en: For a quadratic polynomial \(ax^2 + bx + c\), the sum of the zeroes is \(-\frac{b}{a}\). Here \(a = 1\) and \(b = -2\), so the sum is \(-\frac{-2}{1} = 2\), which is the choice 2.
Q2.hi: द्विघात बहुपद \(ax^2 + bx + c\) के शून्यकों का योगफल \(-\frac{b}{a}\) होता है। यहाँ \(a = 1\) तथा \(b = -2\) है, अतः शून्यकों का योगफल \(-\frac{-2}{1} = 2\) है। सही विकल्प 2 है।

Q3.en: Put \(x = 9\) in the equation: \(\frac{9}{3} + \frac{y}{2} = 6\), so \(3 + \frac{y}{2} = 6\), giving \(\frac{y}{2} = 3\) and \(y = 6\), which is the choice 6.

Q4.en: Split the middle term: \(x^2 + 5x + 6 = x^2 + 3x + 2x + 6 = (x + 3)(x + 2) = 0\). So \(x = -3\) or \(x = -2\), which is the choice \(-3, -2\).

Q5.en: Here the first term is \(a = 3\) and the common difference is \(d = 8 - 3 = 5\). So \(a_{17} = a + 16d = 3 + 16 \times 5 = 83\), which is the choice 83.

Q6.en: The diagonals of a parallelogram bisect each other, so they meet at the mid-point of the diagonal \(AC\): \(\left(\frac{6 + 9}{2}, \frac{1 + 4}{2}\right) = \left(\frac{15}{2}, \frac{5}{2}\right)\). (The mid-point of \(BD\) is the same point.) This is the choice \(\left(\frac{15}{2}, \frac{5}{2}\right)\).
Q6.hi: समांतर चतुर्भुज के विकर्ण एक-दूसरे को समद्विभाजित करते हैं, अतः वे विकर्ण \(AC\) के मध्य-बिन्दु पर काटते हैं: \(\left(\frac{6 + 9}{2}, \frac{1 + 4}{2}\right) = \left(\frac{15}{2}, \frac{5}{2}\right)\)। (विकर्ण \(BD\) का मध्य-बिन्दु भी यही है।) सही विकल्प \(\left(\frac{15}{2}, \frac{5}{2}\right)\) है।

Q7.en: Every equilateral triangle has all its angles equal to \(60^\circ\), so any two of them have equal corresponding angles and are similar. Circles of different radii are similar but not congruent, and rectangles or polygons in general need not have proportional sides or equal angles. So the true statement is "All equilateral triangles are similar."
Q7.hi: प्रत्येक समबाहु त्रिभुज के सभी कोण \(60^\circ\) के होते हैं, अतः किन्हीं दो समबाहु त्रिभुजों के संगत कोण बराबर होते हैं और वे समरूप होते हैं। भिन्न त्रिज्याओं वाले वृत्त समरूप होते हैं, सर्वांगसम नहीं; तथा सभी आयतों या बहुभुजों की भुजाएँ समानुपाती होना आवश्यक नहीं। अतः सही कथन है: "सभी समबाहु त्रिभुज समरूप होते हैं।"

Q8.en: Since \(DE \parallel BC\), the Basic Proportionality Theorem gives \(\frac{AD}{DB} = \frac{AE}{EC}\). So \(\frac{2.0}{BD} = \frac{1.8}{3.6} = \frac{1}{2}\), giving \(BD = 4.0\) cm, which is the choice 4.0 cm.
Q8.hi: चूँकि \(DE \parallel BC\) है, आधारभूत समानुपातिकता प्रमेय से \(\frac{AD}{DB} = \frac{AE}{EC}\)। अतः \(\frac{2.0}{BD} = \frac{1.8}{3.6} = \frac{1}{2}\), जिससे \(BD = 4.0\) सेमी। सही विकल्प 4.0 सेमी है।

Q9.en: By Pythagoras, \(AC = \sqrt{AB^2 + BC^2} = \sqrt{25 + 144} = 13\) cm. For the angle \(A\), the opposite side is \(BC\), so \(\sin A = \frac{BC}{AC} = \frac{12}{13}\), which is the choice \(\frac{12}{13}\).
Q9.hi: पाइथागोरस प्रमेय से \(AC = \sqrt{AB^2 + BC^2} = \sqrt{25 + 144} = 13\) सेमी। कोण \(A\) की सम्मुख भुजा \(BC\) है, अतः \(\sin A = \frac{BC}{AC} = \frac{12}{13}\)। सही विकल्प \(\frac{12}{13}\) है।

Q10.en: Since \(\sin 30^\circ = \frac{1}{2}\) and \(\cos 60^\circ = \frac{1}{2}\), the value is \(4 \times \frac{1}{2} \times \frac{1}{2} = 1\), which is the choice 1.
Q10.hi: चूँकि \(\sin 30^\circ = \frac{1}{2}\) तथा \(\cos 60^\circ = \frac{1}{2}\), अतः मान \(4 \times \frac{1}{2} \times \frac{1}{2} = 1\) है। सही विकल्प 1 है।

Q11.en: Write both terms in sine and cosine: \(\tan A + \cot A = \frac{\sin A}{\cos A} + \frac{\cos A}{\sin A} = \frac{\sin^2 A + \cos^2 A}{\sin A \cos A} = \frac{1}{\sin A \cos A} = \sec A \csc A\). This is the choice \(\sec A \csc A\).
Q11.hi: दोनों पदों को sin और cos में लिखने पर: \(\tan A + \cot A = \frac{\sin A}{\cos A} + \frac{\cos A}{\sin A} = \frac{\sin^2 A + \cos^2 A}{\sin A \cos A} = \frac{1}{\sin A \cos A} = \sec A \csc A\)। अतः सही विकल्प \(\sec A \csc A\) है।

Q12.en: Using \(\sec^2 A = 1 + \tan^2 A = 1 + 3 = 4\), we get \(\sec A = 2\) (for the acute angle \(A = 60^\circ\)). This is the choice 2.
Q12.hi: \(\sec^2 A = 1 + \tan^2 A = 1 + 3 = 4\) से \(\sec A = 2\) (न्यून कोण \(A = 60^\circ\) के लिए)। अतः सही विकल्प 2 है।

Q13.en: Factorise: \(49 = 7 \times 7\) and \(91 = 7 \times 13\). The only common prime factor is 7, so the HCF is 7, which is the choice 7.
Q13.hi: अभाज्य गुणनखंड: \(49 = 7 \times 7\) तथा \(91 = 7 \times 13\)। उभयनिष्ठ गुणनखंड केवल 7 है, अतः HCF = 7। सही विकल्प 7 है।

Q14.en: For two numbers, LCM \(\times\) HCF = product of the numbers. So the other number is \(\frac{182 \times 13}{26} = \frac{2366}{26} = 91\), which is the choice 91.
Q14.hi: दो संख्याओं के लिए LCM \(\times\) HCF = संख्याओं का गुणनफल। अतः दूसरी संख्या \(\frac{182 \times 13}{26} = \frac{2366}{26} = 91\) है। सही विकल्प 91 है।

Q15.en: Tossing two coins gives 4 equally likely outcomes: HH, HT, TH, TT. At least one head occurs in 3 of them (HH, HT, TH), so the probability is \(\frac{3}{4}\), which is the choice \(\frac{3}{4}\).
Q15.hi: दो सिक्के उछालने पर 4 समसंभावी परिणाम हैं: HH, HT, TH, TT (H = चित, T = पट)। इनमें से 3 परिणामों (HH, HT, TH) में कम से कम एक चित है, अतः प्रायिकता \(\frac{3}{4}\) है। सही विकल्प \(\frac{3}{4}\) है।

Q16.en: Use the empirical relation \(3\,\text{Median} = \text{Mode} + 2\,\text{Mean}\). So \(3\,\text{Median} = 20 + 2 \times 26 = 72\), giving Median \(= 24\), which is the choice 24.
Q16.hi: माध्य, माध्यक और बहुलक के आनुभविक संबंध \(3 \times \text{माध्यक} = \text{बहुलक} + 2 \times \text{माध्य}\) से: \(3 \times \text{माध्यक} = 20 + 2 \times 26 = 72\), अतः माध्यक \(= 24\)। सही विकल्प 24 है।

Q17.en: Area of a sector \(= \frac{\theta}{360^\circ} \times \pi r^2 = \frac{30}{360} \times \pi \times 4^2 = \frac{16\pi}{12} = \frac{4}{3}\pi\) cm\(^2\), which is the choice \(\frac{4}{3}\pi\) cm\(^2\).
Q17.hi: त्रिज्या खंड का क्षेत्रफल \(= \frac{\theta}{360^\circ} \times \pi r^2 = \frac{30}{360} \times \pi \times 4^2 = \frac{16\pi}{12} = \frac{4}{3}\pi\) सेमी\(^2\)। सही विकल्प \(\frac{4}{3}\pi\) सेमी\(^2\) है।

Q18.en: Here \(r = 2\) cm and the cone's height \(h = 2\) cm. Volume of the cone \(= \frac{1}{3}\pi r^2 h = \frac{1}{3}\pi \times 4 \times 2 = \frac{8\pi}{3}\) and volume of the hemisphere \(= \frac{2}{3}\pi r^3 = \frac{2}{3}\pi \times 8 = \frac{16\pi}{3}\). Total \(= \frac{24\pi}{3} = 8\pi\) cm\(^3\), which is the choice \(8\pi\) cm\(^3\).
Q18.hi: यहाँ \(r = 2\) सेमी तथा शंकु की ऊँचाई \(h = 2\) सेमी। शंकु का आयतन \(= \frac{1}{3}\pi r^2 h = \frac{1}{3}\pi \times 4 \times 2 = \frac{8\pi}{3}\) तथा अर्धगोले का आयतन \(= \frac{2}{3}\pi r^3 = \frac{2}{3}\pi \times 8 = \frac{16\pi}{3}\)। कुल आयतन \(= \frac{24\pi}{3} = 8\pi\) सेमी\(^3\)। सही विकल्प \(8\pi\) सेमी\(^3\) है।

Q19.en: Total frequency \(N = 2 + 8 + 10 + 5 + 4 + 1 = 30\), so \(\frac{N}{2} = 15\). The cumulative frequencies are 2, 10, 20, 25, 29, 30; the first one greater than 15 is 20, in the class 10-15. So the median class is 10-15, which is the choice 10-15.

Q20.en: The modal class is the class with the highest frequency. The highest frequency is 8, for the class 30-40, so the modal class is 30-40, which is the choice 30-40.
Q20.hi: बहुलक वर्ग वह वर्ग है जिसकी बारंबारता सबसे अधिक हो। सबसे अधिक बारंबारता 8 है, जो वर्ग 30-40 की है। अतः बहुलक वर्ग 30-40 है।

B1a.en:
We prove it by contradiction. Suppose, to the contrary, that \(2\sqrt{2}\) is rational. Then
\(2\sqrt{2} = \frac{p}{q}\), where \(p\) and \(q\) are integers and \(q \neq 0\).
So \(\sqrt{2} = \frac{p}{2q}\).
Since \(p\) and \(2q\) are integers and \(2q \neq 0\), \(\frac{p}{2q}\) is rational, so \(\sqrt{2}\) would be rational.
But \(\sqrt{2}\) is irrational. This contradiction arises from the wrong assumption that \(2\sqrt{2}\) is rational.
Hence \(2\sqrt{2}\) is an irrational number.
B1a.hi:
हम इसे विरोधाभास द्वारा सिद्ध करेंगे। इसके विपरीत, माना कि \(2\sqrt{2}\) एक परिमेय संख्या है। तब
\(2\sqrt{2} = \frac{p}{q}\), जहाँ \(p\) और \(q\) पूर्णांक हैं तथा \(q \neq 0\)।
अतः \(\sqrt{2} = \frac{p}{2q}\)।
चूँकि \(p\) और \(2q\) पूर्णांक हैं तथा \(2q \neq 0\), इसलिए \(\frac{p}{2q}\) परिमेय है, अर्थात् \(\sqrt{2}\) परिमेय होगा।
परन्तु \(\sqrt{2}\) एक अपरिमेय संख्या है। यह विरोधाभास हमारी इस गलत कल्पना के कारण है कि \(2\sqrt{2}\) परिमेय है।
अतः \(2\sqrt{2}\) एक अपरिमेय संख्या है।

B1b.en:
By the distance formula, the distance between \((x_1, y_1) = (-4, 5)\) and \((x_2, y_2) = (2, -3)\) is
\(d = \sqrt{(x_2 - x_1)^2 + (y_2 - y_1)^2} = \sqrt{(2 + 4)^2 + (-3 - 5)^2} = \sqrt{36 + 64} = \sqrt{100} = 10\).
So the distance is 10 units.

B1c.en:
Let the point \((-4, 6)\) divide \(AB\) in the ratio \(k : 1\). By the section formula, its x-coordinate is
\(\frac{3k + (-6)}{k + 1} = -4\)
So \(3k - 6 = -4k - 4\), which gives \(7k = 2\) and \(k = \frac{2}{7}\).
Check with the y-coordinate: \(\frac{-8k + 10}{k + 1} = \frac{-\frac{16}{7} + 10}{\frac{9}{7}} = \frac{54}{9} = 6\), which matches.
Hence the point divides \(AB\) in the ratio \(2 : 7\) (internally).

B1d.en:
Take the common factors out of the left-hand side:
\(\text{LHS} = \frac{2\cos^3\theta - \cos\theta}{\sin\theta - 2\sin^3\theta} = \frac{\cos\theta\,(2\cos^2\theta - 1)}{\sin\theta\,(1 - 2\sin^2\theta)}\)
Using \(\cos^2\theta = 1 - \sin^2\theta\): \(2\cos^2\theta - 1 = 2(1 - \sin^2\theta) - 1 = 1 - 2\sin^2\theta\).
So \(\text{LHS} = \frac{\cos\theta\,(1 - 2\sin^2\theta)}{\sin\theta\,(1 - 2\sin^2\theta)} = \frac{\cos\theta}{\sin\theta} = \cot\theta = \text{RHS}\).
Hence proved.
B1d.hi:
बायाँ पक्ष में उभयनिष्ठ गुणनखंड बाहर निकालने पर:
\(\text{L.H.S.} = \frac{2\cos^3\theta - \cos\theta}{\sin\theta - 2\sin^3\theta} = \frac{\cos\theta\,(2\cos^2\theta - 1)}{\sin\theta\,(1 - 2\sin^2\theta)}\)
\(\cos^2\theta = 1 - \sin^2\theta\) से: \(2\cos^2\theta - 1 = 2(1 - \sin^2\theta) - 1 = 1 - 2\sin^2\theta\)।
अतः \(\text{L.H.S.} = \frac{\cos\theta\,(1 - 2\sin^2\theta)}{\sin\theta\,(1 - 2\sin^2\theta)} = \frac{\cos\theta}{\sin\theta} = \cot\theta = \text{R.H.S.}\)
इति सिद्धम्।

B1e.en:
Length of an arc \(l = \frac{\theta}{360^\circ} \times 2\pi r\). Here \(r = 10.5\) cm and \(\theta = 60^\circ\), so
\(l = \frac{60}{360} \times 2 \times \frac{22}{7} \times 10.5 = \frac{1}{6} \times 66 = 11\) cm.
So the length of the arc is 11 cm.
B1e.hi:
चाप की लंबाई \(l = \frac{\theta}{360^\circ} \times 2\pi r\)। यहाँ \(r = 10.5\) सेमी तथा \(\theta = 60^\circ\), अतः
\(l = \frac{60}{360} \times 2 \times \frac{22}{7} \times 10.5 = \frac{1}{6} \times 66 = 11\) सेमी।
अतः चाप की लंबाई 11 सेमी है।

B1f.en:
The highest frequency is 15, so the modal class is 30-40. Here the lower limit \(l = 30\), class size \(h = 10\), \(f_1 = 15\) (modal class), \(f_0 = 10\) (preceding class), \(f_2 = 11\) (succeeding class).
\(\text{Mode} = l + \frac{f_1 - f_0}{2f_1 - f_0 - f_2} \times h = 30 + \frac{15 - 10}{30 - 10 - 11} \times 10 = 30 + \frac{50}{9} = 30 + 5.56 = 35.56\)
So the mode is approximately 35.56.

B2a.en:
Given: \(TP\) and \(TQ\) are tangents from an external point \(T\) to a circle with centre \(O\).
To prove: \(\angle PTQ = 2\angle OPQ\).
Proof: Let \(\angle PTQ = \theta\).
The lengths of tangents drawn from an external point are equal, so \(TP = TQ\), and \(\triangle TPQ\) is isosceles. Hence \(\angle TPQ = \angle TQP\).
In \(\triangle TPQ\): \(\angle TPQ + \angle TQP + \theta = 180^\circ\), so \(\angle TPQ = \frac{180^\circ - \theta}{2} = 90^\circ - \frac{\theta}{2}\).
The tangent at a point is perpendicular to the radius through that point, so \(\angle OPT = 90^\circ\).
Therefore \(\angle OPQ = \angle OPT - \angle TPQ = 90^\circ - \left(90^\circ - \frac{\theta}{2}\right) = \frac{\theta}{2}\).
So \(\theta = 2\angle OPQ\), that is, \(\angle PTQ = 2\angle OPQ\). Hence proved.
B2a.hi:
दिया है: केन्द्र \(O\) वाले वृत्त पर बाह्य बिन्दु \(T\) से \(TP\) तथा \(TQ\) स्पर्श रेखाएँ हैं।
सिद्ध करना है: \(\angle PTQ = 2\angle OPQ\)।
उपपत्ति: माना \(\angle PTQ = \theta\)।
बाह्य बिन्दु से खींची गई स्पर्श रेखाओं की लंबाइयाँ बराबर होती हैं, अतः \(TP = TQ\) और \(\triangle TPQ\) समद्विबाहु है। इसलिए \(\angle TPQ = \angle TQP\)।
\(\triangle TPQ\) में: \(\angle TPQ + \angle TQP + \theta = 180^\circ\), अतः \(\angle TPQ = \frac{180^\circ - \theta}{2} = 90^\circ - \frac{\theta}{2}\)।
स्पर्श बिन्दु से जाने वाली त्रिज्या स्पर्श रेखा पर लंब होती है, अतः \(\angle OPT = 90^\circ\)।
इसलिए \(\angle OPQ = \angle OPT - \angle TPQ = 90^\circ - \left(90^\circ - \frac{\theta}{2}\right) = \frac{\theta}{2}\)।
अतः \(\theta = 2\angle OPQ\), अर्थात् \(\angle PTQ = 2\angle OPQ\)। इति सिद्धम्।

B2b.en:
Given: \(ABCD\) is a trapezium with \(AB \parallel DC\), and \(EF \parallel AB\) with \(E\) on \(AD\) and \(F\) on \(BC\).
To prove: \(\frac{AE}{ED} = \frac{BF}{FC}\).
Construction: Join \(AC\), cutting \(EF\) at \(G\).
Proof: Since \(EF \parallel AB\) and \(AB \parallel DC\), we have \(EF \parallel DC\).
In \(\triangle ADC\), \(EG \parallel DC\), so by the Basic Proportionality Theorem
\(\frac{AE}{ED} = \frac{AG}{GC}\) ... (1)
In \(\triangle CAB\), \(GF \parallel AB\), so by the Basic Proportionality Theorem
\(\frac{CG}{GA} = \frac{CF}{FB}\), that is, \(\frac{AG}{GC} = \frac{BF}{FC}\) ... (2)
From (1) and (2), \(\frac{AE}{ED} = \frac{BF}{FC}\). Hence proved.
B2b.hi:
दिया है: \(ABCD\) एक समलंब है जिसमें \(AB \parallel DC\) है, तथा \(AD\) पर बिन्दु \(E\) और \(BC\) पर बिन्दु \(F\) इस प्रकार हैं कि \(EF \parallel AB\)।
सिद्ध करना है: \(\frac{AE}{ED} = \frac{BF}{FC}\)।
रचना: \(AC\) को मिलाइए, जो \(EF\) को \(G\) पर काटता है।
उपपत्ति: चूँकि \(EF \parallel AB\) तथा \(AB \parallel DC\), अतः \(EF \parallel DC\)।
\(\triangle ADC\) में \(EG \parallel DC\), अतः आधारभूत समानुपातिकता प्रमेय से
\(\frac{AE}{ED} = \frac{AG}{GC}\) ... (1)
\(\triangle CAB\) में \(GF \parallel AB\), अतः आधारभूत समानुपातिकता प्रमेय से
\(\frac{CG}{GA} = \frac{CF}{FB}\), अर्थात् \(\frac{AG}{GC} = \frac{BF}{FC}\) ... (2)
(1) और (2) से \(\frac{AE}{ED} = \frac{BF}{FC}\)। इति सिद्धम्।

B2c.en:
When a die is thrown twice, the total number of equally likely outcomes is \(6 \times 6 = 36\).
(i) 6 does not come up on either throw when each throw shows one of 1, 2, 3, 4, 5. The number of such outcomes is \(5 \times 5 = 25\).
So P(6 will not come up either time) \(= \frac{25}{36}\).
(ii) "6 comes at least once" is the complement of the event in (i).
So P(6 will come at least once) \(= 1 - \frac{25}{36} = \frac{11}{36}\).
B2c.hi:
एक पासे को दो बार फेंकने पर कुल समसंभावी परिणामों की संख्या \(6 \times 6 = 36\) है।
(i) 6 किसी भी बार नहीं आएगा, जब प्रत्येक बार 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 में से कोई संख्या आए। ऐसे परिणामों की संख्या \(5 \times 5 = 25\) है।
अतः P(6 किसी भी बार नहीं आयेगा) \(= \frac{25}{36}\)।
(ii) "6 कम से कम एक बार आएगा" घटना (i) की पूरक घटना है।
अतः P(6 कम से कम एक बार आएगा) \(= 1 - \frac{25}{36} = \frac{11}{36}\)।

B2d.en:
Make the cumulative frequency table:

| Class interval | Frequency | Cumulative frequency |
|---|---|---|
| 0-5 | 2 | 2 |
| 5-10 | 3 | 5 |
| 10-15 | 8 | 13 |
| 15-20 | 15 | 28 |
| 20-25 | 14 | 42 |
| 25-30 | 8 | 50 |

Here \(N = 50\), so \(\frac{N}{2} = 25\). The first cumulative frequency greater than 25 is 28, so the median class is 15-20.
So \(l = 15\), \(cf = 13\) (cumulative frequency of the preceding class), \(f = 15\), \(h = 5\).
\(\text{Median} = l + \frac{\frac{N}{2} - cf}{f} \times h = 15 + \frac{25 - 13}{15} \times 5 = 15 + \frac{12 \times 5}{15} = 15 + 4 = 19\)
So the median is 19.

B2e.en:
Here \(a = 8\), last term \(l = a_n = 341\) and \(d = 9\).
Number of terms: \(a_n = a + (n - 1)d\), so \(341 = 8 + (n - 1) \times 9\).
\(9(n - 1) = 333\), so \(n - 1 = 37\) and \(n = 38\).
Sum: \(S_n = \frac{n}{2}(a + l) = \frac{38}{2}(8 + 341) = 19 \times 349 = 6631\).
So there are 38 terms and their sum is 6631.

B3a.en:
**Note:** The English print says only "digit of the numbers" is 6 more than the unit's digit, while the Hindi print says the tens digit (दहाई का अंक); the working follows the Hindi, the ten's digit.
Let the ten's digit be \(x\) and the unit's digit be \(y\). Then the number is \(10x + y\), and the number with the digits reversed is \(10y + x\).
First condition: \((10x + y) + (10y + x) = 110\), so \(11x + 11y = 110\), that is, \(x + y = 10\) ... (1)
Second condition: the ten's digit is 6 more than the unit's digit, so \(x = y + 6\) ... (2)
Put (2) in (1): \(y + 6 + y = 10\), so \(2y = 4\) and \(y = 2\).
From (2): \(x = 2 + 6 = 8\).
So the number is \(10 \times 8 + 2 = 82\).
Check: \(82 + 28 = 110\), and \(8 - 2 = 6\).
Hence the number is 82.
B3a.hi:
**टिप्पणी:** अंग्रेज़ी प्रश्न में केवल "digit of the numbers" छपा है, जबकि हिन्दी प्रश्न में संख्या का दहाई का अंक कहा गया है; हल हिन्दी प्रश्न के अनुसार दहाई के अंक को लेकर किया गया है।
माना दहाई का अंक \(x\) तथा इकाई का अंक \(y\) है। तब संख्या \(10x + y\) है, तथा अंकों को पलटने से बनी संख्या \(10y + x\) है।
पहली शर्त से: \((10x + y) + (10y + x) = 110\), अतः \(11x + 11y = 110\), अर्थात् \(x + y = 10\) ... (1)
दूसरी शर्त से: दहाई का अंक इकाई के अंक से 6 अधिक है, अतः \(x = y + 6\) ... (2)
(2) को (1) में रखने पर: \(y + 6 + y = 10\), अतः \(2y = 4\) तथा \(y = 2\)।
(2) से: \(x = 2 + 6 = 8\)।
अतः संख्या \(10 \times 8 + 2 = 82\) है।
जाँच: \(82 + 28 = 110\) तथा \(8 - 2 = 6\)।
अतः अभीष्ट संख्या 82 है।

B3b.en:
Let the base of the right triangle be \(x\) cm. Then its altitude is \((x - 35)\) cm, and the hypotenuse is 65 cm.
By Pythagoras theorem: \(x^2 + (x - 35)^2 = 65^2\)
\(x^2 + x^2 - 70x + 1225 = 4225\)
\(2x^2 - 70x - 3000 = 0\), that is, \(x^2 - 35x - 1500 = 0\).
Split the middle term: \(x^2 - 60x + 25x - 1500 = 0\), so \(x(x - 60) + 25(x - 60) = 0\), that is, \((x - 60)(x + 25) = 0\).
So \(x = 60\) or \(x = -25\). Since a length cannot be negative, \(x = 60\).
Base \(= 60\) cm and altitude \(= 60 - 35 = 25\) cm.
Check: \(60^2 + 25^2 = 3600 + 625 = 4225 = 65^2\).
Hence the other two sides are 60 cm (base) and 25 cm (altitude).

B4a.en:
Let \(AB\) be the multistoreyed building of height \(h\) m, with top \(A\) and foot \(B\), and let \(CD\) be the 6 m building, with top \(C\) and foot \(D\). Let the distance between the buildings be \(BD = x\) m. Draw \(CE \perp AB\); then \(CE = BD = x\) and \(BE = CD = 6\) m, so \(AE = h - 6\).
The angle of depression of the foot \(D\) from \(A\) is \(60^\circ\), so \(\angle ADB = 60^\circ\) (alternate angles).
In right \(\triangle ABD\): \(\tan 60^\circ = \frac{AB}{BD}\), so \(\sqrt{3} = \frac{h}{x}\), that is, \(h = \sqrt{3}\,x\) ... (1)
The angle of depression of the top \(C\) from \(A\) is \(30^\circ\), so \(\angle ACE = 30^\circ\).
In right \(\triangle AEC\): \(\tan 30^\circ = \frac{AE}{CE}\), so \(\frac{1}{\sqrt{3}} = \frac{h - 6}{x}\), that is, \(h - 6 = \frac{x}{\sqrt{3}}\) ... (2)
Put (1) in (2): \(\sqrt{3}\,x - \frac{x}{\sqrt{3}} = 6\), so \(\frac{3x - x}{\sqrt{3}} = 6\), \(2x = 6\sqrt{3}\) and \(x = 3\sqrt{3}\) m.
From (1): \(h = \sqrt{3} \times 3\sqrt{3} = 9\) m.
Hence the height of the multistoreyed building is 9 m, and the distance between the two buildings is \(3\sqrt{3}\) m \(= 3 \times 1.732 = 5.196\) m (about 5.20 m).
B4a.hi:
माना \(AB\) बहुमंजिल भवन है जिसकी ऊँचाई \(h\) मी. है (शिखर \(A\), तल \(B\)), तथा \(CD\) 6 मी. ऊँचा भवन है (शिखर \(C\), तल \(D\))। माना दोनों भवनों के बीच की दूरी \(BD = x\) मी. है। \(CE \perp AB\) खींचिए; तब \(CE = BD = x\) तथा \(BE = CD = 6\) मी., अतः \(AE = h - 6\)।
\(A\) से तल \(D\) का अवनमन कोण \(60^\circ\) है, अतः \(\angle ADB = 60^\circ\) (एकान्तर कोण)।
समकोण \(\triangle ABD\) में: \(\tan 60^\circ = \frac{AB}{BD}\), अतः \(\sqrt{3} = \frac{h}{x}\), अर्थात् \(h = \sqrt{3}\,x\) ... (1)
\(A\) से शिखर \(C\) का अवनमन कोण \(30^\circ\) है, अतः \(\angle ACE = 30^\circ\)।
समकोण \(\triangle AEC\) में: \(\tan 30^\circ = \frac{AE}{CE}\), अतः \(\frac{1}{\sqrt{3}} = \frac{h - 6}{x}\), अर्थात् \(h - 6 = \frac{x}{\sqrt{3}}\) ... (2)
(1) को (2) में रखने पर: \(\sqrt{3}\,x - \frac{x}{\sqrt{3}} = 6\), अतः \(\frac{3x - x}{\sqrt{3}} = 6\), \(2x = 6\sqrt{3}\) तथा \(x = 3\sqrt{3}\) मी.।
(1) से: \(h = \sqrt{3} \times 3\sqrt{3} = 9\) मी.।
अतः बहुमंजिल भवन की ऊँचाई 9 मी. है तथा दोनों भवनों के बीच की दूरी \(3\sqrt{3}\) मी. \(= 3 \times 1.732 = 5.196\) मी. (लगभग 5.20 मी.) है।

B4b.en:
Let \(AB\) and \(CD\) be the two poles, each of height \(h\) m, standing at \(B\) and \(D\) on opposite sides of the road, so \(BD = 60\) m. Let \(P\) be the point on the road between them, with \(BP = x\) m, so \(PD = (60 - x)\) m. The angle of elevation of \(A\) from \(P\) is \(30^\circ\) and that of \(C\) is \(60^\circ\).
In right \(\triangle ABP\): \(\tan 30^\circ = \frac{AB}{BP}\), so \(\frac{1}{\sqrt{3}} = \frac{h}{x}\), that is, \(x = \sqrt{3}\,h\) ... (1)
In right \(\triangle CDP\): \(\tan 60^\circ = \frac{CD}{PD}\), so \(\sqrt{3} = \frac{h}{60 - x}\), that is, \(60 - x = \frac{h}{\sqrt{3}}\) ... (2)
Add (1) and (2): \(60 = \sqrt{3}\,h + \frac{h}{\sqrt{3}} = \frac{3h + h}{\sqrt{3}} = \frac{4h}{\sqrt{3}}\), so \(h = \frac{60\sqrt{3}}{4} = 15\sqrt{3}\) m \(= 15 \times 1.732 = 25.98\) m.
From (1): \(x = \sqrt{3} \times 15\sqrt{3} = 45\) m, and \(60 - x = 15\) m.
Hence the height of each pole is \(15\sqrt{3}\) m (about 25.98 m). The point is 45 m from the pole whose top is seen at \(30^\circ\), and 15 m from the pole whose top is seen at \(60^\circ\).
B4b.hi:
माना \(AB\) और \(CD\) दो खंभे हैं, प्रत्येक की ऊँचाई \(h\) मी., जो सड़क के आमने-सामने बिन्दुओं \(B\) और \(D\) पर खड़े हैं, अतः \(BD = 60\) मी.। माना सड़क पर दोनों खंभों के बीच बिन्दु \(P\) है, जहाँ \(BP = x\) मी., अतः \(PD = (60 - x)\) मी.। \(P\) से \(A\) का उन्नयन कोण \(30^\circ\) तथा \(C\) का उन्नयन कोण \(60^\circ\) है।
समकोण \(\triangle ABP\) में: \(\tan 30^\circ = \frac{AB}{BP}\), अतः \(\frac{1}{\sqrt{3}} = \frac{h}{x}\), अर्थात् \(x = \sqrt{3}\,h\) ... (1)
समकोण \(\triangle CDP\) में: \(\tan 60^\circ = \frac{CD}{PD}\), अतः \(\sqrt{3} = \frac{h}{60 - x}\), अर्थात् \(60 - x = \frac{h}{\sqrt{3}}\) ... (2)
(1) और (2) को जोड़ने पर: \(60 = \sqrt{3}\,h + \frac{h}{\sqrt{3}} = \frac{3h + h}{\sqrt{3}} = \frac{4h}{\sqrt{3}}\), अतः \(h = \frac{60\sqrt{3}}{4} = 15\sqrt{3}\) मी. \(= 15 \times 1.732 = 25.98\) मी.।
(1) से: \(x = \sqrt{3} \times 15\sqrt{3} = 45\) मी., तथा \(60 - x = 15\) मी.।
अतः प्रत्येक खंभे की ऊँचाई \(15\sqrt{3}\) मी. (लगभग 25.98 मी.) है। बिन्दु उस खंभे से 45 मी. दूर है जिसके शिखर का उन्नयन कोण \(30^\circ\) है, तथा दूसरे खंभे से (उन्नयन कोण \(60^\circ\)) 15 मी. दूर है।

B5a.en:
Here \(r = 14\) cm and \(\theta = 60^\circ\); use \(\pi = 3.14\) and \(\sqrt{3} = 1.732\) as given.
Area of the sector \(OAB\) \(= \frac{\theta}{360^\circ} \times \pi r^2 = \frac{60}{360} \times 3.14 \times 14 \times 14 = \frac{615.44}{6} = 102.57\) cm\(^2\) (approx.)
In \(\triangle OAB\), \(OA = OB = 14\) cm and \(\angle AOB = 60^\circ\), so the other two angles are also \(60^\circ\) each and the triangle is equilateral.
Area of \(\triangle OAB = \frac{\sqrt{3}}{4} \times 14^2 = 1.732 \times 49 = 84.868\) cm\(^2\)
Area of the minor segment \(=\) area of the sector \(-\) area of \(\triangle OAB = 102.573 - 84.868 = 17.71\) cm\(^2\) (approx.)
Area of the circle \(= \pi r^2 = 3.14 \times 196 = 615.44\) cm\(^2\)
Area of the major segment \(=\) area of the circle \(-\) area of the minor segment \(= 615.44 - 17.705 = 597.73\) cm\(^2\) (approx.)
Hence the minor segment is about 17.71 cm\(^2\) and the major segment about 597.73 cm\(^2\). (With \(\pi = \frac{22}{7}\) these come to about 17.80 cm\(^2\) and 598.20 cm\(^2\).)
B5a.hi:
यहाँ \(r = 14\) सेमी तथा \(\theta = 60^\circ\); दिए गए मान \(\pi = 3.14\) तथा \(\sqrt{3} = 1.732\) का प्रयोग करें।
त्रिज्यखंड \(OAB\) का क्षेत्रफल \(= \frac{\theta}{360^\circ} \times \pi r^2 = \frac{60}{360} \times 3.14 \times 14 \times 14 = \frac{615.44}{6} = 102.57\) सेमी\(^2\) (लगभग)
\(\triangle OAB\) में \(OA = OB = 14\) सेमी तथा \(\angle AOB = 60^\circ\), अतः शेष दोनों कोण भी \(60^\circ\) के हैं और त्रिभुज समबाहु है।
\(\triangle OAB\) का क्षेत्रफल \(= \frac{\sqrt{3}}{4} \times 14^2 = 1.732 \times 49 = 84.868\) सेमी\(^2\)
लघु वृत्तखंड का क्षेत्रफल \(=\) त्रिज्यखंड का क्षेत्रफल \(-\) \(\triangle OAB\) का क्षेत्रफल \(= 102.573 - 84.868 = 17.71\) सेमी\(^2\) (लगभग)
वृत्त का क्षेत्रफल \(= \pi r^2 = 3.14 \times 196 = 615.44\) सेमी\(^2\)
दीर्घ वृत्तखंड का क्षेत्रफल \(=\) वृत्त का क्षेत्रफल \(-\) लघु वृत्तखंड का क्षेत्रफल \(= 615.44 - 17.705 = 597.73\) सेमी\(^2\) (लगभग)
अतः लघु वृत्तखंड का क्षेत्रफल लगभग 17.71 सेमी\(^2\) तथा दीर्घ वृत्तखंड का क्षेत्रफल लगभग 597.73 सेमी\(^2\) है। (\(\pi = \frac{22}{7}\) लेने पर ये लगभग 17.80 सेमी\(^2\) तथा 598.20 सेमी\(^2\) आते हैं।)

B5b.en:
Radius of the cylinder and of the cone: \(r = 7.5\) cm. Height of the cone \(h = r = 7.5\) cm.
Height of the cylinder \(H = 22.5 - 7.5 = 15\) cm.
Volume of the cylinder \(= \pi r^2 H = 3.14 \times 7.5 \times 7.5 \times 15 = 3.14 \times 843.75 = 2649.375\) cm\(^3\)
Volume of the cone \(= \frac{1}{3}\pi r^2 h = \frac{1}{3} \times 3.14 \times 7.5 \times 7.5 \times 7.5 = 3.14 \times 140.625 = 441.5625\) cm\(^3\)
Volume of the solid \(= 2649.375 + 441.5625 = 3090.9375\) cm\(^3\)
Hence the volume of the solid is about 3090.94 cm\(^3\).

doubts.Q11: Option \(\sin^2 A + \cot^2 A\) is printed as a mix of sin and cot in both languages (a misprint, likely of a sec/cosec form), but it does not affect the answer: \(\tan A + \cot A = \sec A \csc A\) is a printed option.
doubts.B3a: The English print drops "ten's" ("If digit of the numbers is 6 more than unit's digit"); the solution follows the complete Hindi meaning (tens digit 6 more than units digit), giving 82, and opens with a Note in both languages.
doubts.B5a: The note "Use pi = 3.14, sqrt3 = 1.732" is printed after the OR part but sqrt3 is needed only in B5a, so B5a uses pi = 3.14 (17.71 and 597.73 cm2) and adds the pi = 22/7 values (17.80 and 598.20 cm2) in one closing sentence.
